name: Operator Brain
description: The evergreen second-brain skill set for any DUIN user, in six clusters: Judgment (capture/frame/audit), Learning (reflect/resolve), Foresight (forecast/decide), Comprehension (distill/comprehend/recall), Graph (surface/relate/dedup/lint), and Lifecycle (revise/consolidate/archive). Fills and keeps honest the per-operator learning loop, and keeps the knowledge current as it ages.
author: DUIN
